title: SANELA comforter set
description: SANELA comforter set, dark gray-turquoise, King Like a warm embrace. This dark grey-turquoise comforter in pure cotton has velvet on the surface and a thick filling that insulates against heat and cold – even during the coldest winter nights. Pillow sham with a closure in the middle of the back.
features: Thread count indicates the number of threads per square inch of fabric. The higher the thread count the more densely woven the fabric.
Filling weight is measured in ounces per square yard. The higher the filling weight, the fluffier and warmer the comforter.
The roll-packed, compressed comforter regains its original shape and fluffiness after a few days.
Filling density is measured in ounces per square yard. The higher the filling density, the fluffier and warmer the comforter.
Comprises: 1 King size comforter 108x92'' (274x234 cm) and 2 King size pillow shams 20x36'' (51x91 cm).
materialAndCare: Top fabric/ Back fabric: 100 % cotton; Filling: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)
